**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve floating-point values when taking absolute values**

Use `std::abs` for these floating-point animation values. Here `vx` and `vy` are in `[-1, 1]`, but the unqualified `abs` resolves to the integer overload in this translation unit, truncating almost every value to zero; Euler2d therefore loses its red/green velocity coloring and vectors. The same generated catalog contains this pattern in several other selectable effects, so the generator should normalize floating-point `abs` calls before regenerating the catalog.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Allow the screensaver row in the stock-menu check**

Update this assertion to account for the newly added `Screensaver` row. Running the documented `python3 companion/host/boot-tests/run_stock_restoration_checks.py` command on this commit always fails here because the current setup menu no longer has the same label list as the parent commit, so the runner exits before executing any of its remaining stock-restoration checks.
